items.question: What is the maximum range of a pneumatic tube system?
items.answer: The SU-6 model supports distances up to 380 m. For longer routes (up to 600 m), intermediate blowers are used.

items.question: Can an existing system be expanded?
items.answer: Yes. We recalculate the system capacity and add new stations and pipework. Our engineers will help with planning.

items.question: What pressure is used in the system?
items.answer: Between 0.5 and 1 bar — sufficient to move capsules weighing up to 1 kg at speeds up to 8 m/s.

items.question: What happens if a capsule gets stuck?
items.answer: The system automatically reverses the airflow to free the capsule. Inspection hatches are also installed at critical points for manual access.

items.question: What does a minimum system cost?
items.answer: A basic point-to-point system (two stations) starts from €2,800. The final price depends on the number of stations, pipe length and site specifics.

items.question: Can the tube run between separate buildings?
items.answer: Yes — through underground ducts, cable channels or overhead bridges. We have experience with such projects.

items.question: How noisy is the system?
items.answer: The blower is installed in a technical room. Noise at workstations does not exceed 45 dB — roughly equivalent to a quiet office.

items.question: Can equipment from different manufacturers be combined?
items.answer: Technically yes, if they are compatible. However, for reliable warranties and servicing we recommend keeping to a single manufacturer.
